risk.summary: Extreme VIX crisis regime (372.96) dominates risk assessment; normal yield curve provides limited offset; earnings in 78 days presents moderate event risk for energy sector.

debate.key_bull_argument: Strong uptrend structure (ADX trending, EMA 50/200 bullish, price above SMA 200) with extreme market fear (28/100) creating contrarian buy opportunity in energy sector ahead of earnings.
debate.key_bear_argument: Overbought conditions (RSI 14: 72.14, Stoch K: 89.09) combined with bearish momentum crossovers (MACD, Stochastic), crisis-level VIX (372.96), zero fundamental conviction, and price positioned near resistance (74.3312) create elevated pullback risk with poor risk/reward.
